subject: Embeddings pricing and bundle structure questions
messages:
From: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@dataforge.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@dataforge.io
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings pricing — baseline units, bundles, and model compatibility

Hi Vanessa / Aditya,

Thanks for taking this off the RFP. A few clarifying questions from our engineering and procurement teams so we can finish the internal cost model:

- Can you confirm Redwood's baseline hosted API pricing for embeddings (per-vector) by dimension? Specifically: 1536-dim and 512-dim examples.
- Do you bill per-vector only, or is there a token-based or per-request component we should model for context tokens (we run several multi-chunk embed flows)?
- What bundle/commit discount tiers do you offer for annual commitments (1M vectors, 10M vectors, 50M+)? Any minimums?
- Which embedding model variants are available on hosted (we need a pair: a high-accuracy 1536 variant and a low-cost 512 variant for filtering)?
- Is bulk export of vectors supported (for migration) and are there egress or export fees?

I've attached the RFP excerpt with expected volumes (page 4: vector volumes by quarter). Procurement is trying to get a quick baseline to compare against two other vendors.

Appreciate any sample cost math (e.g., cost for 10M vectors at 1536 dims vs 512 dims) and a short note on packaging options — we may prefer a committed bundle if the price delta is material.

Best,
Emma

Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing — baseline units, bundles, and model compatibility

Emma — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and I attached a short pricing snapshot XLSX in the next mail:

- Baseline pricing (hosted API, list):
  - 1536-dim (redwood-emb-large-v1): $0.00045 per vector
  - 512-dim (redwood-emb-lite-v1): $0.00018 per vector
  - We price per completed embedding vector generated; there is no additional per-request token charge for the embedding generation itself (context tokens for chunking are priced separately only for text-generation endpoints).
- Bundle/commit discounts (annual prepay):
  - 1M vectors: 8% off list
  - 10M vectors: 18% off list
  - 50M+ vectors: 30% off list + priority ingestion lanes
  - Minimum 12-month term for bundle discounts; monthly uncommitted usage stays at list price.
- Models on hosted: redwood-emb-large-v1 (1536d), redwood-emb-lite-v1 (512d), and community/open variants for specific compat testing (we can surface model ids if you want to pin).
- Bulk export: supported via our export job API. Export itself is free; standard egress charges apply if you pull out of our hosted region to an external cloud provider — we can model egress for your expected destination.

Quick sample math (list price):
- 10M vectors @ 1536d: 10,000,000 * $0.00045 = $4,500 list. With 18% committed discount = $3,690/year.
- 10M vectors @ 512d: 10,000,000 * $0.00018 = $1,800 list. With 18% = $1,476/year.

Notes: we can do blended pricing if you want a single per-vector rate across dims (useful if you have mixed workloads). Also offer an annual throughput SLA upgrade for high-volume ingestion.

Let me know if you'd like a formal quote (I'll pull Marissa in for contractual terms). Can you confirm target destination for exports (S3 us-west-2 or other)?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Folks — a couple internal points to include in the formal proposal:

- Retention/storage: our hosted offering includes 90 days of hot vector retention by default. Longer retention (6/12/24 months) is an add-on priced by GB/month; for their volumes we should estimate storage cost separately.
- Volume commitments: offer a slightly higher upfront discount for Q1 proof-of-value with the remainder paid over the year (helps procurement sign).
- Migration/export: confirm destination. If they want full managed export to a non-AWS target, add a one-time service fee.

Marissa — can you draft the standard commercial sheet (SOW + payment terms) with those options?

—Aditya
Account Director | Redwood Inference

Emma / Procurement — attaching a short snapshot with the pricing tables and two packaging options:

1) Committed bundle (recommended): 12-month prepay, 10M vectors/year at 18% off, includes 180-day hot retention and priority ingestion.
2) Pay-as-you-go: list per-vector price, 90-day retention, no ingestion SLA.

Attachment: sample_embeddings_pricing.xlsx (contains line items for vector unit price by dimension, storage bands by TB, and optional migration service fee).

Next steps: if the committed bundle looks good we'll send a commercial sheet and a short SOW. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk the math. Proposed times: Thu 9/10 11am PT or Fri 9/11 9am PT.

Best,
Vanessa

1) Can you give a short estimate for export egress costs to S3 us-west-2 for 10M 1536d vectors (we'll likely want a one-time export after the migration run)?
2) Do you support an intermediate lower-dimension quantized export (e.g., 256-d) for archival to reduce storage costs? If so, is there any quality guarantee or recommended downsampling approach?

We can confirm a time for the sync — Thu 9/10 11am PT works for our engineering and procurement leads.

Paul (cc) runs procurement — copying him so he can flag anything else.

Best,
Emma
